scope: Standardized v2 pilot startup and infrastructure repairs

events.observation: The first launch compiled and cached the required CuRobo extensions, then made no progress before episode creation.
A cached rerun reproduced the pre-episode block, ruling out one-time extension compilation as the remaining cause.
A SIGUSR1 faulthandler dump localized the main thread to SAPIEN renderer construction before task setup.

The host exposed multiple Vulkan ICDs. Pinning /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/nvidia_icd.json and clearing forwarded DISPLAY made the official SAPIEN offscreen example complete and allowed the unchanged frozen model cells to run.

The first public Google Storage checkpoint restore followed stale local Application Default Credentials and received HTTP 401 before any policy server or episode existed. Setting FSSPEC_GS_TOKEN=anon selected anonymous access for the public checkpoint; the complete checkpoint then restored and all retained probes and episodes used that unchanged local snapshot.

retention_rule: Only attempts that reached model inference and emitted result.json are scientific episodes. All pre-episode failures remain in this technical ledger and never enter success-rate denominators.
